_meta.purpose: Engineer-authored per-factor display text for the UI. NEVER include strings from the rules engine or rich engine here — the safety contract relies on UI free text coming from a vetted vocabulary, not from engine output. Same provenance model as data/officialContentCards.json.

age.label: Age
age.whyItMatters: Age shapes which NHS preventive checks you're invited to. The NHS Health Check is offered every five years to adults aged 40 to 74 who don't already have certain long-term conditions.

blood_pressure.label: Blood pressure
blood_pressure.whyItMatters: Blood pressure rarely has symptoms, so the only way to know is to get it checked. Many pharmacies in England offer free walk-in checks to anyone aged 40 or over.

cholesterol.label: Cholesterol
cholesterol.whyItMatters: A simple blood test from a GP or pharmacy tells you your cholesterol numbers. Knowing them helps a preventive-care conversation be more useful.

smoking.label: Smoking status
smoking.whyItMatters: Smoking status is a major preventive factor. Free NHS support to stop smoking is available through local services, GPs, and pharmacies.

bmi_or_waist.label: BMI or waist size
bmi_or_waist.whyItMatters: Body measurements help frame general preventive advice. The NHS has free tools for working out your BMI and small everyday changes that add up.

cvd_history.label: Heart and circulation history
cvd_history.whyItMatters: If you've already been told you have cardiovascular disease, your care team manages this with you rather than the general NHS Health Check pathway.

diabetes.label: Blood sugar
diabetes.whyItMatters: An existing blood-sugar condition is followed up through your GP rather than the general NHS Health Check. Your team monitors related checks routinely.

hypertension.label: High blood pressure
hypertension.whyItMatters: If high blood pressure has already been picked up, your GP manages it directly — the general NHS Health Check route doesn't apply.

kidney_disease.label: Kidney health
kidney_disease.whyItMatters: Chronic kidney disease is followed up through your GP. Routine kidney health is part of the wider preventive picture for adults.
